posts.title: Welcome to Times of Lakshadweep
posts.sum: Your independent island news and cultural portal is live on GitHub.
posts.body:
Welcome to Times of Lakshadweep. This website is now live, featuring full coverage of island affairs, administration updates, education, sports, jobs, and lifestyle.

News editors can log in to the Admin Portal to write, edit, upload photos, and publish new stories in real time.
posts.author: Chief Editor

pages.title: About Us
pages.body:
Times of Lakshadweep is dedicated to bringing independent, accurate, and timely journalism to the people of Lakshadweep and the global diaspora.

We cover local news, governance policies, marine environment, education, sports, and cultural heritage from every island including Kavaratti, Agatti, Andrott, Amini, Kadmat, Kiltan, Chetlat, Bitra, Kalpeni, and Minicoy.
